qst.apprentice.crypt.desc: The marks continue underground: the Resonance Crypt.
qst.apprentice.crypt.title: Beneath the stone
qst.apprentice.decide.desc: Tarn looks at you from the rubble. Decide.
qst.apprentice.decide.o0: Decide what to do about Tarn
qst.apprentice.decide.title: A decision
qst.apprentice.name: The Apprentice
qst.apprentice.return.title: Back to Hesk
qst.apprentice.search.desc: Look for Tarn's camp in the Quarry.
qst.apprentice.search.title: Trail
qst.apprentice.summary: Tarn, Hesk's apprentice, vanished in the Quarry with six others. Only his compass came back.
qst.empty_choir.crypt.desc: Recover the Resonant Core from the Resonance Crypt beneath the quarry.
qst.empty_choir.crypt.title: The Crypt
qst.empty_choir.door.desc: Take the Core to the Bell Gate, to the south.
qst.empty_choir.door.title: The Gate
qst.empty_choir.end.title: Parting words
qst.empty_choir.ildra.desc: Ildra sings beneath a shield of voice. Break it with a chord.
qst.empty_choir.ildra.title: The Precentor
qst.empty_choir.name: The Empty Choir
qst.empty_choir.summary: The Bell Gate seals Ildra, the Emptied Precentor. Only the Resonant Core from the Crypt opens the resonance curtain.
qst.first_echo.meet.title: A warden
qst.first_echo.name: The First Echo
qst.first_echo.path.desc: Follow the Bell Path east to Orrel's Step.
qst.first_echo.path.title: The Path
qst.first_echo.quarry.desc: Brass drones and their hollow foreman block the quarry, to the east.
qst.first_echo.quarry.title: The Quarry
qst.first_echo.report.title: Report
qst.first_echo.summary: You wake voiceless beneath the First Canticle. The only village still standing, Orrel's Step, needs someone who makes no echo.
qst.first_echo.wake.desc: A voice cylinder blinks beside you. Listen to it.
qst.first_echo.wake.title: Awakening
qst.footprints.chamber.desc: Cross the door and face what sings on the other side.
qst.footprints.chamber.title: Discord Chamber
qst.footprints.door.desc: The footprints end at the Harps wall. Turn the three symbols in the order you found them.
qst.footprints.door.title: The door that is not a door
qst.footprints.glyphs.desc: Listen near silent stone: the overlook, the harps (in a storm) and a mouthless statue.
qst.footprints.glyphs.title: Three glyphs
qst.footprints.name: Footprints That End at the Wall
qst.footprints.summary: A glyph rang beneath the stone. They say there are three, and that together they open something that is not a door.
qst.silent_bells.bells.desc: Strike the five bells, north of Orrel's Step, in the order the sentences dictate.
qst.silent_bells.bells.title: The bells
qst.silent_bells.clues.desc: The tablets are in Orrel's hall, the Windharps and the Overlook.
qst.silent_bells.clues.o0: Read the three tablets (Orrel, Harps, Overlook)
qst.silent_bells.clues.title: Three sentences
qst.silent_bells.name: The Clapperless Bells
qst.silent_bells.summary: Maeve says clapperless bells ring by themselves. Three tablets scattered around the valley tell in what order.
